name: Create an IPsec tunnel
description: Create an IPsec tunnel Creates a new IPsec tunnel associated with an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels
Creates a new IPsec tunnel associated with an account. Use `?validate_only=true` as an optional query parameter to only run validation without persisting changes.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)
Optional: x-magic-new-hc-target (header) — If true, the health check target in the request and response bodies will be presented using the new object format. Defaults to false.

name: Generate Pre-Shared Key (PSK) for IPsec tunnels
description: Generate Pre-Shared Key (PSK) for IPsec tunnels Generates a Pre-Shared Key for a specific IPsec tunnel used in the IKE session. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels/{ipsec_tunnel_id}/psk_generate
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels/{ipsec_tunnel_id}/psk_generate
Generates a Pre-Shared Key for a specific IPsec tunnel used in the IKE session. Use `?validate_only=true` as an optional query parameter to only run validation without persisting changes. After a PSK is generated, the PSK is immediately persisted to Cloudflare's edge and cannot be retrieved later. Store the PSK in a safe place.
Required: ipsec_tunnel_id (path); account_id (path)

description: Set Pre-Shared Keys (PSK) for IPsec tunnels Sets Pre-Shared Keys for multiple IPsec tunnels associated with an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/ipsec_tunnels/psk
context:
